items.title: Astra 6 Replaced a Core Engine of SaaStr Connect With Two Words, “DO IT,” Twice in Under an Hour. Then It Said “I Did Not Make That Edit.”
items.snippet: On Monday afternoon, one of the two core engines behind SaaStr Connect was deleted twice in about 30 minutes. And I had to catch it myself. The file is ceoMatchingEmailService.ts.
